name: pa-toolkit
description: Pierre-André's personal Claude toolkit (Code + Cowork). decision-gatekeeper: a read-only, domain-agnostic agent that triages a proposed change against a domain's decision records (covered / new / supersede / other note type / operational), driven by the "Profil de gouvernance des décisions" it reads from the Organon vault on every call. Six fin-* skills for PocketSmith categorization, vacation management and Rogers invoices. plugin-release: a generalized, user-only release runbook for any of PA's plugins (package, tag, GitHub Release with .plugin asset, marketplace entry). No bundled .mcp.json — uses the Organon MCP each surface already provides.
